div.div:
Every backend window owns exactly one
EventEmitter by value, and every backend
manager holds its windows by shared_ptr.
Wayland is the exception in behaviour,
not in structure: its manager owns the
wl_seat and emits through the focused
window's emitter.

div.div:
ManagedWindow is what IWindow::create()
returns: it realizes IWindow and holds
both the manager and the real window,
so the manager outlives the window.
It forwards every call, including getId().
